title: grga related signals v3
description: Contract for `grga related --json` under the v9 keyword-primary architecture. See docs/design/related-signals-v3.md. v3.0 (2026-07-13): `--mode graph` now returns candidate *keywords* (RelatedKeyword) instead of documents; the pre-v3 `expansion` block, `crossed_scopes_preview`, `keyword_contributions`, and `graph_signals` are all gone (PPR + doc aggregation removed in Phase 3b-2). `--mode heading` retains the doc-oriented shape minus the removed fields. `--mode dir` is removed entirely (raises at CLI level; use `grga search --json | aggregate` instead). Replaces schemas/related-signals-v2.json.

anyOf.$comment: graph mode envelope — candidate keywords with association evidence. An empty results array is also valid for either mode.
heading mode envelope — documents that share a Markdown chapter with a seed-containing doc

related_keyword.description: One candidate keyword expanded from a seed via chunk_cooccur or llm_promoted evidence in `keyword_pairs`.

npmi.description: Normalized pointwise mutual information stored at build time. For chunk_cooccur edges: > 0 and typically <= 1. For llm_promoted edges: stored as 0.0 (NPMI is NULL in the DB but promoted here so the JSON shape stays uniform).

cooccur_count.description: Raw chunk co-occurrence count of (via_seed, kw) at build time.

via_seed.description: Which seed produced this candidate. Multi-seed queries return per-seed rows without cross-seed fusion; a candidate keyword reachable from multiple seeds appears multiple times with different via_seed values.

chunk_df.description: Candidate keyword's own scope-level chunk df (from keyword_stats.chunk_df). Hub-word discriminator: caller may filter e.g. `chunk_df / total_chunks_in_scope > 0.1` client-side. 0 when the candidate has no keyword_stats row (only reachable via llm_promoted edges without corpus evidence).

source.description: Edge provenance. `chunk_cooccur` = derived from build-time chunk co-occurrence. `llm_promoted` = written by `grga index promote` after LLM voting.

related_doc.description: One related document (heading mode only). No `keyword_contributions` in v3 — that block was PPR-specific and PPR was removed in Phase 3b-2.

keywords.description: Heading paths matched between the seed docs and this doc (sorted).
